segment_summary.zh: 本段沿灰色地砖通道继续朝明亮门洞前进，门洞和其后的木地板区域逐渐放大；右侧棕色竖向木质结构持续存在并更靠近，F15右缘露出相邻空间的一角。尚未穿门洞、右转或到达挂两幅画的墙前。
segment_summary.en: In this segment the view continued along the gray-tiled passage toward the bright doorway, and the doorway and the wooden floor beyond gradually enlarged; the brown vertical wooden structure on the right remained present and came closer, while F15 exposed a corner of an adjacent space at the right edge. The doorway has not yet been crossed, no right turn has been made, and the wall with two framed pictures has not been reached.

reason.zh: 观测显示相机仍在灰色地砖走廊内朝门洞前进，右侧棕色柱/木结构逐渐接近，这与沿走廊直行并准备从右侧经过棕色柱的当前要求相符；没有证据显示已进入错误通路，但进入开放起居区及其后右转、客厅和餐桌位置仍未确认。
reason.en: The observations show the camera still moving forward along the gray-tiled corridor toward the doorway, with the brown pillar/wooden structure on the right gradually approaching, which is consistent with the current requirement to go straight along the corridor and prepare to pass the brown pillar on the right; there is no evidence of entering a wrong passage, but entry into the open living area and the subsequent right turn, living room, and dining table location remain unconfirmed.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Continue straight, passing a brown pillar on your right as you enter an open living area.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 继续直行，在进入开放起居区时从右侧经过一根棕色柱子。

instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 右转，使带沙发和电视的主客厅区域保持在左侧。

description.zh: 四帧中灰色地砖前景、中央白色门洞和门洞后的木地板连续可见，门洞随前进放大，表明相机沿同一通道向门洞接近。
description.en: Across the four frames, the gray-tiled foreground, the central white doorway, and the wooden floor beyond the doorway are continuously visible; the doorway grows larger with forward motion, indicating that the camera is approaching the doorway along the same passage.

description.en: The brown vertical wooden structure on the right remains at the right edge across the four frames and is closer and occupies a larger area in F15, consistent with being before passing the brown pillar on the right.

description.zh: F15右缘可见相邻空间的一角，有白色软装/坐具与绿植，但仅凭此不能确认已进入该空间或完成右转。
description.en: At the right edge of F15 a corner of an adjacent space is visible, with white soft furnishing/seating and a plant, but this alone cannot confirm that the space has been entered or that the right turn has been completed.

semantic_progress.zh: 截至S03：S01之前的路线仍未确认。此前记录的灰色地砖走廊和左侧卫生间可作为历史进度保留；本段继续朝明亮门洞前进，右侧棕色木质结构逐渐接近，F15已到门洞近前并见相邻空间一角。尚未确认已穿过门洞进入开放起居区，也未确认按指令右转、左侧沙发电视、右侧餐桌椅及挂两幅画墙面等后续要求。
semantic_progress.en: As of S03: the route before S01 remains unconfirmed. The previously recorded gray-tiled corridor and left-side bathroom can be retained as historical progress; in this segment the view continued toward the bright doorway, the brown wooden structure on the right gradually came closer, and at F15 the camera is near the doorway with a corner of an adjacent space visible. It is not yet confirmed that the doorway has been crossed into the open living area, nor that the instructed right turn, sofa/TV on the left, dining table/chairs on the right, or the wall with two framed pictures have been reached.
